correctness.rationale: Conditional on each renewal schedule, independent Brownian excursions yield exactly a product of no-hit factors. Independent groups multiply conditional-survival moments. The schedule-conditioned survival is nondegenerate for every positive time/rate. Strict Cauchy-Schwarz proves power-moment log-convexity; Chebyshev covariance proves strict coarsening; finite balancing transfers give sharp majorization extremizers. A uniform two-block reset-and-hit event proves exponential first-hit tails and integrability. The code runs 1533 exact rational assertions as illustration, not infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The earliest inspected source arXiv:2303.18012 resolves the two extreme clock-allocation protocols but does not give the fixed-number-of-clocks partition extremizers or a majorization stochastic order at every deadline. Other close publications concern stationary particle positions, collective resets to state-dependent locations, or all-walkers encounter events. Classical power-moment log-convexity is explicitly credited as a proof ingredient, not claimed original. Dedicated searches found no prior exact grouped-first-hit classification; an unlocated equivalent specialization is the remaining priority risk.
residual_risks: Power-moment log-convexity and positive covariance are classical. An unidentified earlier multi-searcher resetting paper might already draw the precise fixed-k majorization conclusion.
Some physically related newer papers and the complete technical text of arXiv:2509.06658 were not fully inspected; their studied observables appear different from first-to-hit clock allocation.
No independent scholarly priority audit was conducted.

value.rationale: The fixed number of shared reset controllers is a natural resource constraint in the exact Brownian multi-searcher model. The theorem solves the entire integer-partition allocation optimization simultaneously at all deadlines and rates and in first-passage stochastic order. This is stronger than optimizing mean time for two endpoint protocols and provides complete sharp extremizers without evaluating a separate complicated renewal integral for every partition. It is a structural comparison, not an unmotivated small numerical perturbation.
